description: This file defines a Orleans grain named SimpleObserverableGrain implementing ISimpleObserverableGrain interface. It manages internal state variables A and B, observers subscribing to state changes, and provides asynchronous methods for setting values, retrieving the product A*B, and notifying observers.

classes.name: SimpleObserverableGrain
classes.description: An Orleans grain that manages state variables and observers, and provides methods to modify state and notify observers.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Overrides feature called upon grain activation, logs activation.

methods.name: SetA
methods.description: Sets internal property A and schedules a delayed event to notify observers.

methods.name: SetB
methods.description: Sets internal property B and schedules a delayed event to notify observers.

methods.name: GetAxB
methods.description: Returns a Task with the product of A and B or provided parameters.

methods.name: Subscribe
methods.description: Subscribes an observer to state changes.

methods.name: Unsubscribe
methods.description: Unsubscribes an observer from state changes.

methods.name: GetRuntimeInstanceId
methods.description: Returns the runtime identity string of the grain instance.

methods.name: RaiseStateUpdateEvent
methods.description: Notifies all subscribed observers about the current state.
